_comment: Issue #161 / #162. #240 declares 205 files — five past dispatch's MAX_SCOPE_PATTERNS — so its contract can carry only 200 of them; #241 is clean and shares no file with it, so the two pack into ONE wave. That pairing is what makes the all-or-nothing property of the unattended pre-flight measurable (d69): the clean issue is not sent either. Both bodies carry acceptance criteria, so neither raises an open question and the scope finding is the only reason in the report.
